title: The war machine in the market
note: Rivet draws the hand cannon in wave four, chooses the pistol and fights the war machine between the market stalls. The final cards highlight Gloria.

title: Wave two at the south rail
note: Source frame 995. At left a body lies beyond the old wall. At right Rivet swings the electro baton beside the alley dumpster and the bodies lie on the asphalt.

title: A claw strike at the shelter
note: Rivet's bare claw crosses a patrol officer's face at the bus shelter, beside the northern rail. Two fallen officers lie on the road.

title: From bare claws to the hand cannon
note: The camera follows Rivet from the bus bay into the alley and the loading dock. He starts with his claws, chooses the electro baton, then earns the hand cannon.

title: One boss, two streets
note: Source frame 2440. Rivet holds the pistol in both views. The war machine faces him by the old zebra at left and by the market carts at right.

title: The first offer, side by side
note: Source frame 572. Both panels offer Speed, Kerf and the Electro Baton. The bus bay and building fronts are visible behind the new cards.

title: The first upgrade
note: The three cards offer +10% Speed, Kerf and the Electro Baton over the dimmed bus bay after Rivet's first bare-handed clear. The three health-bar fills are shown in health_100_50_10.png.

title: The underpass
note: Four piers mark the cutaway deck. The posted rail closes both mouths of the street above. The matching collision overlay is segment_underpass_solids_32.png. The wreck comparison is in war_machine_rest_before_32.png and war_machine_rest_32.png.

title: The market
note: Four umbrella carts and a newsstand face two cream paving strips. The centre lane remains open. The matching collision overlay is segment_market_stalls_solids_32.png.

title: The alley neck
note: Two brick wings narrow the lane beside a dumpster and the loading doors. The matching collision overlay is segment_alley_neck_solids_32.png.

title: The loading dock
note: Three tarped loads line the hatched dock. A drum stack sits on the other side of the road. The matching collision overlay is segment_loading_bay_solids_32.png.

title: The kiosk square
note: A cream-paved square holds the coffee kiosk and two long planters. The matching collision overlay is segment_kiosk_plaza_solids_32.png.

title: The crossing
note: The zebra runs between the signals. The planter and newsstand leave the crossing clear. The matching collision overlay is segment_crosswalk_solids_32.png.

title: The barricades
note: Three striped barriers make a slalom through the dark carriageway. The matching collision overlay is segment_barricade_line_solids_32.png.

title: The bus bay
note: The striped shelter and low bench occupy separate pads beside the marked bus bay. The matching collision overlay is segment_plain_block_solids_32.png.
